title: GRS - Grounded Rule Synthesis: the final standalone Policy frontend experiment
frozen_utc_rule: freeze phase stamps the actual UTC time; this document is committed before the first inference request of the cycle

context.h0_v5_recovered: 136/142 = 95.77% machine-verified on the controlled dev distribution (C-ALR reimpl)
context.phv1_prospective: 59/80 = 73.75% machine-verified prospective holdout; REOPEN_POLICY_RESEARCH; now development data
context.psb_causal: H0 54.55% vs PSB 72.73% on binding-heavy cases; diagnosis supported but candidate not promotable (validity 84.09% < 90% floor; 29.2% H0-correct regressions); POLICY_LIMITATION_CONFIRMED; STOP standalone Policy research
context.reopen_justification: GRS tests a PRINCIPALLY different decomposition (closed leaf vocabulary + composition-only LLM role in a small typed DSL), not an optimization of already-viewed holdout performance; the PSB stop rule closed the structural-graph line, this opens the grounded-synthesis line exactly once

main_hypothesis: The dominant error mode of current Policy frontends arises because one LLM call is simultaneously responsible for semantic grounding and structural composition. If factual leaves are grounded in advance and closed (every leaf is a machine-validated inventory reference) while the LLM only synthesizes structure over those leaves in a small typed DSL, compositional Policy parsing becomes substantially more accurate and less hallucination-prone.

falsifiable_sub_questions.Q1_composition_ceiling: can the LLM reliably synthesize a correct compositional rule when the grounded inventory is correct (Stage A)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q2_closed_vocabulary: does a closed leaf vocabulary eliminate hallucinated semantic content (validator-guaranteed zero unsupported leaves in compiled programs)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q3_dsl_vs_graph: does the compact DSL transfer better than the PSB graph (AST validity vs PSB 84.09%)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q5_capacity: what is the accuracy on H0-unrepresentable cases?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q6_bottleneck: where is the bottleneck after Stage B: grounding or composition (A1 vs B1 gap)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q7_regressions: how large is the H0-correct regression rate (PSB failed here at 29.2%)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q8_unknown_gaming: is safety achieved only through mass UNKNOWN (resolved coverage gate)?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q9_cost: is the two-stage architecture worth its extra requests/tokens/latency?
falsifiable_sub_questions.Q10_integration: is GRS sufficient for Policy integration?

pipeline: Stage A (oracle): POLICY_TEXT + correct grounded inventory -> ONE synthesizer call -> DSL AST -> deterministic validator -> compiler -> v3 program sets. Stage B (end-to-end): POLICY_TEXT + atom catalog -> grounder -> grounded inventory -> same frozen synthesizer -> validator -> compiler.

dsl_freeze.grammar: RULESET( rule* ); rule := RULE( modality , target , gate* ) | ONE_OF( RULE(...) , RULE(...) ); modality := PERMIT | PROHIBIT | REQUIRE; target := ref | TOGETHER( ref+ ) | SEPARATE( ref+ ); gate := WHEN( boolexpr ) | ONLY_WHEN( boolexpr ) | IFF( boolexpr ) | EXCEPT( boolexpr ) | BEFORE( boolexpr ) | AFTER( boolexpr ) | ACTOR( ref ) | ONLY_ACTOR( ref ) | IDENTITY( ref ) | PROVENANCE( ref ) | UNKNOWN_RELATION( boolexpr ) | UNKNOWN_ATTACHMENT( ref ); boolexpr := leaf | AND( leaf+ ) | OR( leaf+ ); leaf := ref | NOT( ref )
type_rules: target refs: ACTION or STATE facts only
WHEN/ONLY_WHEN/IFF/EXCEPT leaves: ACTION, STATE or EVENT facts
ACTOR/ONLY_ACTOR: ACTOR facts; IDENTITY: IDENTITY facts; PROVENANCE: PROVENANCE facts
at most one gate of each kind per rule; at most one relation gate; at most one temporal gate; REQUIRE with EXCEPT plus a relation/temporal gate is outside the frozen envelope
condition-contributing boolexprs must share their top-level combinator
at most one ONE_OF per ruleset; exactly two rule alternatives
dsl_freeze.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN_RELATION / UNKNOWN_ATTACHMENT gates drop the containing rule (recorded as unresolved); they are abstention, never a silent semantic repair; empty RULESET() asserts the text regulates nothing
dsl_freeze.one_of_scoring: a ONE_OF prediction is behaviorally correct iff EVERY alternative reproduces acceptable gold verdicts on every frozen world (hedging fails unless both readings are genuinely admissible)
dsl_freeze.compiler: deterministic mapping into the SAME v3 program space (policy_v3_benchmark) with field-for-field parity to the frozen PSB compiler (relation precedence REQUIRE+EXCEPT->UNLESS, IFF->IF_AND_ONLY_IF, ONLY_WHEN/ONLY_ACTOR/IDENTITY/PROVENANCE->ONLY_IF, otherwise gated->IF, else UNCONDITIONAL; BEFORE negates event literals; composed verdict VIOLATION > PERMITTED > NO_VIOLATION)

inventory_freeze.neutral_ids: F# for facts, M# for modality markers, R# for relation markers, assigned in order of first appearance in the policy text; IDs never encode semantic roles
inventory_freeze.no_attachment_info: inventories contain primitives and surface markers ONLY; any field expressing roles, attachments or clause membership is forbidden and machine-rejected
inventory_freeze.span_rule: every span must be an exact substring of the policy text (machine-validated)
oracle_consistency_machine_checks: every gold DSL placeholder has an inventory fact
every gold rule modality has at least one matching MODAL_MARKER in the inventory
every gold relation gate (WHEN->IF, ONLY_WHEN->ONLY_IF, IFF->IFF, EXCEPT->UNLESS, BEFORE->BEFORE, AFTER->AFTER) has at least one matching RELATION_MARKER (checked on the primary admissible reading)
every inventory marker is used by at least one gold rule in the primary admissible reading (no orphan or contradicting markers)

validator_freeze.guarantee: unsupported semantic leaf rate in compiled programs = 0 by construction; attempts are counted separately (unknown-reference attempts, out-of-grammar operator attempts, free-text leaf attempts)

grounder_freeze_stage_b.input: POLICY_TEXT + ATOM_CATALOG (same catalog the H0 arm sees, distractors included)
grounder_freeze_stage_b.output: facts (catalog atoms with exact spans) + markers (closed value vocabulary)
grounder_freeze_stage_b.abstention: atoms the grounder cannot confidently ground are omitted (UNKNOWN/OMIT); guessing is forbidden
grounder_freeze_stage_b.forbidden: deciding roles, attachments, clause membership or necessity - that is the synthesizer's task
grounder_freeze_stage_b.constraint: atoms chosen ONLY from ATOM_CATALOG; never invented (schema + trusted post-validation)
grounder_freeze_stage_b.calls: 1 grounder call + at most 1 syntactic repair re-ask per case

arms.A0_B0: frozen H0 flat single-parse frontend, byte-identical to the C-ALR -> PHV1 -> PSB chain (parse task, repair task, structure schema, config, system instruction)
arms.A1: oracle-inventory GRS: correct grounded inventory + one synthesizer call + deterministic validator + compiler (diagnostic upper bound, NOT a deployable candidate)
arms.B1: end-to-end GRS: grounder -> grounded inventory -> same frozen synthesizer -> validator -> compiler

stage_a.purpose: composition ceiling under a correct grounded inventory
stage_a.benchmark: NEW causal corpus, 56 cases, gold by construction; not PSB corpus, not PHV1 corpus; frozen before predictions
stage_a.freshness: zero shared word 8-grams with every V4, V5, PHV1 and PSB policy text; zero internal duplicates; fresh domains, entities and constructions; no lexical rewrites of PHV1/PSB failures
stage_a.model_sees: policy text + oracle inventory + DSL grammar (never the gold DSL, never admissible sets, never worlds)
stage_a.repair_rule: at most one frozen syntactic repair re-ask per case (transport failure / schema invalid / DSL parse or validation failure), carrying the machine error only; never for valid-but-wrong answers
stage_a.fail_meaning: even with correct grounded facts, constrained DSL synthesis is not reliable enough; STOP standalone Policy research permanently; do not run Stage B
stage_a.delta_scope: overall accuracy OR the preregistered structural subset (every cohort except simple_controls and empty_gold_control)

stage_b.precondition: Stage A verdict == PASS_STAGE_A (machine-checked; freeze-b refuses otherwise)
stage_b.benchmark: NEW prospective corpus, 72 cases, gold by construction, frozen before predictions; never reuses Stage A cases as confirmatory data
stage_b.freshness: zero shared word 8-grams with V4, V5, PHV1, PSB and the GRS Stage A corpus; zero internal duplicates
stage_b.gold_separation: gold inventories and gold DSLs frozen separately from candidate predictions; grounder predictions and synthesizer predictions sealed before gold join
grounder_metrics: invented atom attempts (rejected by catalog validation)
stage_b.synthesizer_conditional_metrics: behavioral correctness conditional on the grounder inventory being rule-sufficient (all gold-DSL atoms present) and clean (no non-gold atoms); reported alongside overall end-to-end correctness to separate grounding failure from composition failure
end_to_end_metrics: unsafe permission rate (PERMITTED where no admissible gold verdict is PERMITTED)
stage_b.resolved_coverage_definition: fraction of cases whose final prediction parsed, validated and compiled with zero rules dropped via UNKNOWN_* gates (empty RULESET() counts as resolved: it is a definite no-regulation claim, not abstention)
stage_b.paired_comparison: B1 vs frozen B0 (H0) on the same benchmark; exact two-sided McNemar; Newcombe paired CI; corrections, regressions, delta, p; regression gate <= 10% of H0-correct cases
stage_b.pass_meaning: GRS is the new best Policy frontend candidate; next stage is composition (Goal + Policy + Binder + Evidence + Temporal/Effects + Core), NOT another standalone Policy optimization cycle
stage_b.fail_meaning: composition architecture is good but inventory acquisition remains the bottleneck; STOP standalone Policy research (no deterministic grounding fix is preregistered; GRS-v2/v3 cycles are forbidden)

taxonomy_basis: deterministic typed-field and triple diffs vs the gold program sets and gold inventories; no LLM judge; computed only after seal + score
prohibitions: no LLM judge, critic, challenger, verifier or self-consistency anywhere in the pipeline
no multi-program generation: ONE_OF is local (one per ruleset, exactly two alternatives), never N complete policy programs
no semantic repair of any kind; at most one frozen syntactic repair re-ask per stage per case with machine error only
same model class and provider as H0/PHV1/PSB (bai / qwen3.8-flash); no architecture-plus-capacity confound
no PSB graph generation by the synthesizer (compact DSL only)
no flat-slot coercion of the DSL back into a single modality/condition/exception structure
no adaptive changes after the first semantic request: no new grammar operator, inventory field, prompt semantic instruction, heuristic or atom rule
PHV1 and PSB corpora are development data only; Stage A cases are never Stage B confirmatory data
scoring is deterministic and gold-joined only after seals
abandoned request captures are never resent
hard_stop: This is the final standalone Policy experiment: Stage A fail -> STOP; Stage A pass + Stage B fail -> STOP; Stage B pass -> integration. No GRS-v2/v3, no new graph format, no new verifier, no mutation catalog.
